title: Server-owned safe spawn and per-player objective placement
human_decisions_pending: Owner approval of the detailed TCK-0003 plan in docs/features/first-playable/plan.md is required before PLAN_APPROVED. The proposed boundary permits implementation changes only in src/shared/GameLoop/ObjectivePlacement.luau, src/server/GameLoop/SafeSpawnObjectiveAdapter.luau, src/server/Bootstrap.server.luau, tests/GameLoop/ObjectivePlacement.spec.luau, and tests/GameLoop/SafeSpawnObjectiveAdapter.spec.luau; it defers objective qualification and lifecycle success, timers/failures, reset/replay/reposition, respawn orchestration, client presentation, remotes, persistence/economy, publishing, and multi-place work; and it requires the planned static/Lune matrices, independent review, and scoped one-player/two-player Studio evidence.
